description: Model weights for RecursiveAI.OneOcr. The recognizer, the page detector and the word language model are embedded when the package is built with OneOcrModelFile, OneOcrDetectorFile, OneOcrLanguageModelFile and OneOcrWordFrequencyFile pointing at the pinned files (see models.json).
Local, deterministic OCR for .NET with no dependencies beyond the base class library and RecursiveAI.OneImage.

Document extraction weights for RecursiveAI.OneOcr: invoice, receipt and key-value fields. The model is embedded when the package is built with OneOcrDocumentModelFile pointing at the pinned file (see models.json).
Opt-in language-model vision for RecursiveAI.OneOcr: Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenAI-compatible, Gemini and Azure OpenAI over plain HttpClient. This is the only OneOcr package with networking code.

Fine-tuning for RecursiveAI.OneOcr recognition models from your own documents: an LLM labels the lines, lines the local reader agrees with train the model, the rest go to a review queue. Reaches the network only through RecursiveAI.OneOcr.Llm.
PDF bridge for RecursiveAI.OneOcr: text-layer words where a page has them, local OCR for scanned regions, one page model.
The oneocr command-line tool: fine-tune a recognition model from your own documents (train), measure it (eval) and work through the lines that need a human look (review).
Portable bounded process requests, monotonic budgets, retained session contracts and lifecycle observations.

sWidget for .NET: widgets configured in the Superroute back office, loaded by their id on the app's sApp connection, as view models over the sApp UI kit (Superroute.SApp.UI) and the sLocker kit, drawn by Superroute.SWidget.Wpf and Superroute.SWidget.WinForms.
sWidget for Windows Forms: SwidgetControl, the widget configured in the Superroute back office, drawn by the sApp WinForms kit from Superroute.SWidget's view model.
sWidget for WPF: SwidgetControl, the widget configured in the Superroute back office, drawn by the sApp WPF kit from Superroute.SWidget's view model.
Caller-retained BCL process sessions with bounded observation and explicit best-effort retirement policies.
